# Bergeys Coffee Co.

> Family-run coffee trailer in Venice, Florida, owned by husband-and-wife duo Jason and Mia Bergeron. Brewing up sunshine in Venice since 2023. Serves espresso drinks, chai, matcha, iced teas and house-made syrups, proudly serving Bergeron Roasters coffee. Rated 5.0 stars from 212 Google reviews.

## Key facts
- Name: Bergeys Coffee Co. (Google category: Coffee stand)
- Address: 1600 Banyan Dr, Venice, FL 34293, USA (corner of U.S. 41 Bypass and Center Rd)
- Phone: (941) 599-1964
- Email: bergeyscoffeeco@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 7:00 AM–4:00 PM; Sunday closed
- Price range: $
- Owners: Jason and Mia Bergeron
- Founded: 2023
- Amenities: outdoor seating, wheelchair-accessible entrance and parking lot
- Coffee: Bergeron Roasters (sister roastery) — online store https://bergeron-roasters.square.site/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/bergeyscoffeeco/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/p/Bergeys-Coffee-Co-100095026822387/
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Bergeys+Coffee+Co.&query_place_id=ChIJv5s5R1Gmha4RB5hW4ZKPujY

## Pages
- [Home, menu, reviews, visit info](https://rgwebd.github.io/bergeyscoffee/): story, full drink menu, gallery, Google reviews, hours and map

## Menu (drink prices are posted at the trailer)
- Coffee: Espresso, Macchiato, Cortado, Cappuccino, Latte, Americano, Brewed Coffee, Cold Brew
- Drinks: Chai, Matcha, Hot or Iced Chocolate, Lemonade
- Iced Teas: Hibiscus Berry, Lemon Ginseng, English Breakfast
- Seasonal syrups (fall): Pumpkin Spice, Sea Salt Maple
- Beans at the trailer: 1 lb $20, 5 lbs $100
- Dairy-free milk options available

## Catering
- Espresso Bar Package starting at $600: 2 hours of bottomless hot & iced drinks, personal barista, full menu (brewed coffee, specialty lattes, matcha, chai), syrups, sugars & milk alternatives, upscale cups & lids. Custom printed latte art (monograms to photo portraits). Larger events quoted on request.
